segments.text: If you were born on the ninth, the eighteenth, or the twenty-seventh, this is your number. Moolank nine.
Your ruling planet is Mars, and your element is fire. That is why your energy never seems to run out.
Courage, and a sense of justice so strong that you take a stand and you hold it.
Lucky numbers three, six and nine. Colour red. Day Tuesday.
Your daily remedy. Chant Om Angarakaya Namah. Read the Hanuman Chalisa, and donate blood. It cools the anger, and turns restless fire into courage.
